name: Lentils (Mixed Varieties)
description: Lentils are a premier, hyper-dense legume whole food matrix. Unmatched in the plant kingdom for their rapid preparation and high protein-to-weight ratio, they integrate massive distributions of metabolic B-vitamins, critical non-heme iron, and robust prebiotic fibers, making them an elite functional asset for sustained blood sugar control, cardiovascular tone, and deep cellular repair.
macroIntro: The macronutrient configuration of cooked lentils offers a highly efficient distribution of clean botanical proteins and slow-fusing complex polysaccharides designed for steady metabolic endurance and lean tissue maintenance.
microIntro: Lentils house an extensive network of water-soluble coenzymes and essential trace minerals engineered to maximize red blood cell assembly and optimize mitochondrial energy synthesis.

macroNutrients.name: Calories
macroNutrients.description: Provides low-density, highly efficient biological energy that yields an immense nutritional payoff without contributing to excess caloric storage.

macroNutrients.name: Protein
macroNutrients.description: A powerful source of plant protein, extraordinarily rich in essential amino acids like lysine and leucine to drive structural cellular remodeling and recovery.

macroNutrients.name: Total Fat
macroNutrients.description: Virtually fat-free, keeping gastric clearance times exceptionally quick and enabling efficient utilization of its core micronutrient network.

macroNutrients.name: Carbohydrates
macroNutrients.description: Composed of complex, slow-burning starches intricately bound within an advanced structural fiber matrix to prevent sharp postprandial glucose shifts.

microNutrients.name: Vitamin B9 (Folate)
microNutrients.description: A monumental concentration of natural folate, serving as a mandatory coenzyme for DNA synthesis, rapid cellular division, and systemic homocysteine control.

microNutrients.name: Manganese
microNutrients.description: An abundant dose of this trace mineral catalyst, critical for activating mitochondrial antioxidant enzymes and supporting bone matrix stability.

microNutrients.name: Dietary Fiber
microNutrients.description: Packed with exceptional insoluble and soluble prebiotic fibers that physically expand in the digestive tract to modulate sugar assimilation rates.

microNutrients.name: Iron (Non-Heme)
microNutrients.description: A massive botanical reservoir of non-heme iron, essential for driving efficient hemoglobin assembly and continuous tissue oxygen transport.

microNutrients.name: Phosphorus
microNutrients.description: Works in a strict physiological loop with calcium to support structural bone density and maintain cellular ATP energy configurations.

microNutrients.name: Vitamin B1 (Thiamin)
microNutrients.description: An indispensable coenzyme facilitating continuous carbohydrate metabolism cascades and driving smooth central nervous system signaling loops.

healthBenefits: Elite Postprandial Glycemic Regulation: The robust combination of high-density plant proteins and dense dietary fibers dramatically delays carbohydrate processing, yielding an exceptionally flat glucose response curve.

Advanced Erythropoiesis & Oxygen Flow: Exceptional natural levels of Folate working alongside concentrated non-heme iron stores accelerate the synthesis of healthy red blood cells, reversing internal fatigue markers.

Cardiovascular Endothelial Defense: Massive distributions of Vitamin B9 actively metabolize circulating homocysteine, shielding delicate blood vessel walls from oxidative decay and preserving arterial elasticity.

Microbiome Soluble Fermentation: Robust prebiotic fiber structures pass completely intact into the lower bowel, where beneficial microflora ferment them into short-chain fatty acids that actively repair the intestinal lining.
precautionsIntro: Even though lentils function as an elite botanical powerhouse, their dense structural fibers and native defensive compounds require targeted tracking parameters.
precautions: Anti-Nutrient Lectin & Phytic Acid Shifting: Raw or undercooked lentils contain phytic acid and lectins that can chelate vital trace minerals and irritate the intestinal wall. Because lentils lack a rigid outer coat, thorough boiling or a brief soaking phase easily dismantles these barriers.

Gastrointestinal Oligosaccharide Bloating: The rich presence of complex prebiotic fibers can trigger intensive bacterial fermentation in the lower intestine for sensitive digestive profiles, causing temporary lower abdominal gas or bloating.

Non-Heme Iron Absorption Blocks: Because the extensive iron density present is strictly non-heme, its absorption can easily be suppressed by native plant compounds. Pairing cooked lentils with fresh citrus elements or other sources of Vitamin C heavily optimizes intestinal absorption paths.

Renal Purine & Potassium Filtration: Lentils carry a concentrated purine and potassium distribution. Individuals navigating advanced chronic kidney disease (CKD) or hyperuricemia should calibrate portion sizing to protect filtration pathways.
